description: This file contains mock classes and functions for simulating subprocess execution and process management, used for testing purposes within the webkitpy project. It defines classes like MockProcess and MockExecutive, and functions such as mock_git_commands, to facilitate controlled testing of system interactions.

classes.name: MockProcess
classes.description: Simulates a process with stdout, stderr, and methods to wait, poll, and communicate.

classes.name: MockExecutive
classes.description: Mocks system executive commands, providing methods to run commands, handle processes, and simulate process management.

methods.name: MockProcess.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a mock process with specified stdout, stderr, and default attributes.

methods.name: MockProcess.wait
methods.description: Placeholder for waiting on process completion.

methods.name: MockProcess.poll
methods.description: Checks if the process has completed based on stdout and stderr reading progress.

methods.name: MockProcess.communicate
methods.description: Returns the current stdout and stderr contents.

methods.name: MockExecutive.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the mock executive with configurable logging, error throwing, and command output.

methods.name: MockExecutive.run_command
methods.description: Simulates running a system command, returning predefined output or raising exceptions based on configuration.

methods.name: mock_git_commands
methods.description: Creates a mock function to simulate git command responses based on a provided dictionary.
